description: Implement export endpoints and UI: add export() methods to all 4 controllers (WaterLevelController, ConsumptionReadingController, RestrictionController, ScheduledCutController) to handle both PDF and Excel formats via query parameter ?format=pdf or ?format=excel. Create PDF view templates. Add 'Export PDF' and 'Export Excel' buttons to all 4 index views. Add routes for export endpoints. Filters must be passed through query parameters so export respects applied filters.
steps: Add 4 routes to routes/web.php in the 'back' group: GET back/water-levels/export, back/consumption-readings/export, back/restrictions/export, back/scheduled-cuts/export — use route name export (e.g., back.water-levels.export)

Add export() method to WaterLevelController: accept Request, extract zone_id and type_source from query, call DroughtExportService::getWaterLevelsForExport(), render PDF if format=pdf (using dompdf) or return WaterLevelExport::download() if format=excel. File names: drought-water-levels-{date}.pdf or .xlsx
Add export() method to ConsumptionReadingController: same pattern, extract zone_id only, call DroughtExportService::getConsumptionReadingsForExport()
Add export() method to RestrictionController: extract zone_id, statut, type; call DroughtExportService::getRestrictionsForExport()
Add export() method to ScheduledCutController: extract zone_id, statut; call DroughtExportService::getScheduledCutsForExport()

Create resources/views/back/drought/exports/water-levels-pdf.blade.php: landscape orientation, header with 'Water Levels Report', export date, manager name (Auth::user()->name), table with all columns, page numbers in footer
Create resources/views/back/drought/exports/consumption-pdf.blade.php with same layout for consumption data
Add 'Export PDF' and 'Export Excel' buttons to resources/views/back/drought/levels/index.blade.php above the table, preserving current filter parameters in URLs
acceptance_criteria: All 4 export routes are defined in web.php and accessible (verified with `php artisan route:list | grep export`)
GET /back/water-levels/export?format=pdf returns a PDF file with Content-Type: application/pdf and correct filename
GET /back/water-levels/export?format=excel returns an Excel file with proper headers and formatting
PDF exports respect all filters: ?zone_id=1&type_source=barrage exports only that subset
Export buttons are visible on all 4 index pages
Clicking export buttons preserves current filter state in the export file
verification: php artisan test — all tests pass (no new failures)
Manual test each export route: curl 'http://localhost:8000/back/water-levels/export?format=pdf&zone_id=1' > /tmp/test.pdf && file /tmp/test.pdf (should show PDF)
Manual test Excel: curl 'http://localhost:8000/back/water-levels/export?format=excel' > /tmp/test.xlsx && file /tmp/test.xlsx (should show Microsoft Excel)
Open a browser to /back/water-levels, apply filter (e.g., zone_id=1), click 'Export PDF', verify downloaded file contains only zone 1 data
Repeat for Excel and all 4 tables
